SELECT s.name as systemName, s.client_id as systemId, COUNT(*) as totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN r.task_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as totalCompleted, SUM(CASE WHEN r.task_status = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as totalInProgress, SUM(CASE WHEN r.task_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as totalFailed, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN r.task_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 100 WHEN r.task_status = 'RUNNING' THEN 50 ELSE 0 END ), 2), 0) as avgProgressPercentage FROM t_task_realtime_monitor r JOIN sys_system s ON r.system_code = s.client_id
r.start_time >= CURRENT_DATE
AND s.client_id IN
#{systemId}
GROUP BY s.client_id, s.name ORDER BY s.client_id
